name: Slovenské školské prázdniny (multijazyčné, openpotato/OpenHolidays)
title: Slovenské školské prázdniny (multijazyčné, openpotato/OpenHolidays)
description: School-vacation periods (školské prázdniny) of the Slovak Republic as published by the OpenHolidays API and seeded from the openpotato/openholidaysapi.data monorepo.  Each record describes a single vacation window with start/end dates, regional scope (which Slovak kraje the holiday applies to), and parallel names in Slovak (default), German, and English.  Distinct vacation stems include: Jarné prázdniny, Jesenné prázdniny, Letné prázdniny, Veľkonočné prázdniny, Vianočné prázdniny.  Per-kraj resolution is captured in `subdivision_codes` and the human-readable `subdivision_names_sk` (joinable to sk-kraje-iso via ShortName).  This is the first school-holiday dataset in the SK bucket (no pre-existing sk-skolske-* slug).

meta.description: School-vacation periods (školské prázdniny) of the Slovak Republic as published by the OpenHolidays API and seeded from the openpotato/openholidaysapi.data monorepo.  Each record describes a single vacation window with start/end dates, regional scope (which Slovak kraje the holiday applies to), and parallel names in Slovak (default), German, and English.  Distinct vacation stems include: Jarné prázdniny, Jesenné prázdniny, Letné prázdniny, Veľkonočné prázdniny, Vianočné prázdniny.  Per-kraj resolution is captured in `subdivision_codes` and the human-readable `subdivision_names_sk` (joinable to sk-kraje-iso via ShortName).  This is the first school-holiday dataset in the SK bucket (no pre-existing sk-skolske-* slug). Obsahuje 62 záznamov. Stiahnuť vo formátoch Excel, CSV, PDF.
